description: This file contains the regional (locale) configuration for the jQuery UI datepicker plugin for the English ('en') locale. It initializes localization settings such as month names, day names, button texts, date formats, and other regional preferences, and sets these defaults for the datepicker.

methods.name: factory
methods.description: The main function that initializes the regional settings for the datepicker. It is invoked immediately with the datepicker module as an argument.
